items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember if you ever played in Henry Allen's band? ... [INTERVIEWEE] ...had a brass band that pushed famous over there. Because he played at all those bands.

ctx.x: See, at the time, yeah, all that. When we played with the Creole Serenators, Oh, yes. The Peter Bocas. The father was Paul. Had Peter, Henry, and Charlie, three sons, and their brother-in-law, Teo.
That was L'Renzetio. Yes, L'Renzetio. Married their sister, I know. Yeah.
